description:
test/report_test.exs:234 (describe 'report: :full', @describetag :clang) asserts that Full's dot/2 hot loop has exactly one {:vectorize, :vectorized, why} fact with 'width' in why.

Seen failing once on 2026-10-11 by the defk-djy.7 agent in a full mix test run: clang gave no vectorisation remark for the loop. The agent reported the same failure with its changes stashed, so the cause was not its change. Not reproduced since: 3 isolated runs (mix test test/report_test.exs --only clang) and 2 full-suite runs (seeds 678569, 253049) all passed; the defk-djy.11 agent's full run passed too. Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), macOS 26.6.

Suspects to check: the remark pass or the .remarks file racing another test that builds the same module or cleans _build/test/defk (async tests, a shared cache path); a timeout or load-dependent fallback that drops remarks; remark parsing when clang writes several remark files. Compare with defk-cwl (another under-load flake).

Done when the cause is found and fixed, or the test is made robust to it, and a loop of full mix test runs under load (e.g. 20 runs with a CPU hog) shows no failure.

comments.text: 2026-10-11 ~14:15: the defk-djy.3 agent saw it fail on every rerun in its worktree, also with its changes stashed, while load average was ~30-50 on 12 cores (5 agents running). Passed in isolation and in full runs at lower load earlier. Strong hint it's load-dependent (timeout or remark pass dropped under contention).

NOT reproduced: 20 isolated report-test runs (remarks cache removed each time) at load 25-55, plus 11 full mix test runs at load 35-180 with 8-12 CPU hogs, 3 concurrent same-worktree runs x8: the 'dot hot loop vectorises' test never failed. Ruled out: timeout (remark pass has none, System.cmd blocks), clang non-determinism (no budget; remark file identical), async races (report tests async:false, Full compiled once per run). Remaining plausible: lib/defk/build.ex remarks! cached a torn/empty .remarks (non-atomic File.write!, killed run) which then fails every rerun until the cache key changes, matching 'failed on every rerun'; also cc --version probe failing under load -> clang? false silently. Hardened: atomic write, empty/remark-less cache = miss, pid in temp names; test added (fails without the fix). Other flakes seen under load are different causes: frames_live destructor race (cwl family: MultiClauseTest, BitstringHelperTest, RaiseCleanupTest, BitstringTest killed-mid-build), 60s ExUnit timeouts (ScaledFactsTest properties, BinaryLiteralsTest). Reopen if it recurs, with the .remarks file kept.

Reopened by the coordinator: the cause was not reproduced (20 isolated + 32 parallel + 11 full runs under load, no failure). cda979a hardens the .remarks cache (atomic write, a file with no remark line is a miss) but that is a suspect, not a proven cause. Unproven second suspect: 'cc --version' failing under load makes clang?/0 return false. If it recurs: keep the .remarks file and log remark_pass's exit status and output.

Cause found (coordinator, 2026-10-11), deterministic, not load: the cached .remarks files hold absolute paths of the checkout that built them (e.g. /Users/.../defk/_build/test/defk/Elixir.Defk.ReportTest.Full-<hash>.c). Repro: create a worktree, copy _build from another checkout, run 'mix test test/report_test.exs --only clang' -> 'dot's hot loop vectorises' and 'an empty cached .remarks file is a miss' fail every time; the same tests pass in the checkout that built the cache. Every failing sighting was in an agent worktree whose _build had been copied from main (djy.3, djy.7, djy.13 ...), which is why it 'failed on every rerun' there. The cache key (hash) matches, but the remark lines name another checkout's .c path, so they don't attach to this module. Real-world impact: a project directory that is moved or restored from a CI/Docker cache at another path silently loses vectorisation facts from report: :full. Fix: make the cached remarks path-independent (store paths relative to the build dir, or match remarks by the .c basename), or include the absolute build path in the cache key; add a test that copies a built cache to a different directory.

Fixed on branch defk-fr7/remarks-path-independent. Remark lines are now normalised to the .c basename in Defk.Build.parse_remarks, and Defk.Report.full matches by Path.basename(base <> '.c'). The basename holds module+cache key, so it identifies this kernel; the cache stays valid after a move (cheaper than keying on the build dir). Repro test: copies the built cache to another dir and compares Report.full facts (failed with 'clang gave no remark', passes now). Other path-dependent artefacts: __defk_lib__/0 compiles the absolute .so path into the beam (moved project with stale beam points at old .so; relevant to defk-n8f releases, not fixed here); the cached .c/.so themselves embed no paths needed for correctness. mix test: 1 failure in bitstring_helper_test under load, passes alone (cwl family).

title: Flaky: ReportTest 'dot's hot loop vectorises' sometimes gets no vectorisation remark from clang
